explicit_clock.claim: elapsed time is linearly decodable at the elicitation slot in all tested models

no_clock.claim: a length-aligned time prior is common and model-specific, not universal

verbal_readout.claim: stated duration is model-dependent and less reliable than the activation probe
verbal_readout.qwen_exception: verbal estimate anti-correlates with the internal probe

limitations: pilot scale with grouped cross-validation by conversation
talkie and granite leak narrated schedule information into the no-clock read
DeepSeek has no measured no-clock length signal
positive fitted rates are not evidence of phenomenological time experience
cross-version transformer captures are not fully within-version
